_doc: Subscription plan capacity in API-equivalent USD (the CLI's own notional price), used to show a path's estimate as a share of a plan's 5-hour window and week. Not published by the vendors: Claude rows are user measurements; refresh when they move. Codex rows are estimates (2026-11-15): OpenAI publishes local messages per 5-hour window (Plus: 15-160 GPT-6.1 Sol messages), says a typical task uses 2-15 credits on GPT-5.6 Sol (half that on GPT-6.1 Sol, whose credits per token are half) and its credit rates per token are 25 times the API dollar rates (GPT-6.1 Sol: 50 credits vs USD 2 per million input tokens), so 1 credit is about USD 0.04 of API price; so a Plus window is about 15 x 0.30 to 160 x 0.04 = USD 4.5 to 6.4; 5.5 is used. null: the plan has no such limit (Pro has no 5-hour window) or OpenAI does not publish it (every weekly limit).

plans.label: Max 5x
plans.source: not measured: window 5x Pro (published multiplier); week half of Max 20x (botfarm.run, Feb 2026: 523 vs 1,100)
